g.text: Like games, mathematics tests a system: many steps, new arguments.
There is a real aim too: tools that help mathematicians work.
GenAI writes text that looks right. A proof has to be gap-free.
A proof assistant checks every step: Lean, with its library Mathlib.
AlphaProof learns by trying proofs in Lean and reading the checker.
2026: OpenAI's ten advances, and a proposed Navier-Stokes solution
with a Lean formalization. Both still need mathematical scrutiny.
A checked proof is a very high standard of verification.
Tao: "there's more to mathematics than rigour and proofs".
We also want to know why. We use Lean later in the course.
